gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool / capital allocation: already-selected VBB paper entries may deserve more notional when volume-breadth thrust intensity is materially above the accepted minimum. This matches the playbook's free breadth/internal-structure lane.

2_history_check.accepted_vbb: exp-20260526-014 accepted the shared default-off VBB paper adapter: EV +0.7124 and PnL +$13,225.50 vs core, 47 paper trades, 3/3 windows.
2_history_check.difference: This does not expand ticker count, retune VBB pass thresholds, change top-N, or add a live filter; it tests a production-visible breadth-intensity support field on selected paper trades.
2_history_check.nearby_failures: exp-20260526-017 rejected IWM>SPY gating; exp-20260526-018 found VBB rank monotonicity unstable; exp-20260526-019 rejected same-day core activity support.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows, before=exp014 VBB adapter, after=best predeclared breadth-intensity support variant; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, no EV/PnL-regressed window, >=10 adjusted trades across all windows, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, survival >=5%, and concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: The accepted VOLUME_BREADTH_BREAKOUT_PAPER source may have better replacement value when selected trades occur on stronger breadth thrust days. Same-day volume_breadth_fraction is a free OHLCV market-internal field already produced by the accepted VBB helper.
interpretation: Accepted: breadth-intensity support passed Gate 4 versus the accepted exp014 VBB adapter and is retained only in the shared default-off VBB paper adapter. Live/default orders remain disabled.
